item.title: Fort Worth-Based HTeaO Adds Two Executives as Franchise Chain Prepares for 40 New Stores in 2026
item.description: Fort Worth-based iced tea franchise HTeaO has appointed Jerry McClain and Brian Aga to key leadership roles as the company prepares for more than 40 new store openings in 2026.

item.title: Manny Ramirez: Lower the Temperature in Politics and Return to Results
item.description: In a time of political polarization and viral outrage, Tarrant County Commissioner Manny Ramirez argues that real leadership is measured by competence, civility, and results that strengthen communities.

item.title: Presidio Begins Trading on NYSE as $735M Fort Worth Oil and Gas Company
item.description: Fort Worth-based Presidio Production Co. launches as a public company after completing its business combination with EQV Ventures Acquisition Corp.

item.title: $1.7B Westside Village Development Breaks Ground Near Fort Worth Cultural District
item.description: The 37-acre project near the Cultural District will bring offices, retail, housing, and a hotel to the former Fort Worth ISD headquarters site.

item.title: Bonds Ellis Expands Litigation Team With Partner David Garza
item.description: The firm says Garza brings experience handling complex commercial disputes and high-stakes contract cases across Texas.

item.title: Texas Senate Rift Echoes 1961 Election That First Broke One-Party Dominance
item.description: Texas Republicans face a dangerous split in the Cornyn–Paxton Senate fight — one that resembles the Democratic fracture that helped elect John Tower in 1961.

item.title: Artificial Intelligence Is Coming to Local Government — Fort Worth Is Preparing Now
item.description: From faster permitting to smarter infrastructure maintenance, AI is changing how cities operate. Here’s why Fort Worth is leaning in — carefully.

item.title: The Problem With Our Health Care System Is It Ain't Broken
item.description: No, it's working just as it's designed to. A Fort Worth physician argues that rising costs, rushed appointments, and endless bureaucracy are not system failures but the predictable results of incentives built into modern health care.

item.title: Fort Worth-Based Aquila Air Capital Hires Aviation Finance Veteran as VP of Origination
item.description: Matthew Schneider, an aviation finance veteran with nearly three decades of experience in leasing and deal origination, will help expand the Fort Worth-based aircraft engine lessor’s business across the Americas.

item.title: Thrust Flight Opens Fort Worth Campus at Spinks Airport for Pilot and Aircraft Mechanic Training
item.description: Thrust Flight has opened a new aviation training campus at Spinks Airport in Fort Worth, offering accelerated pilot training and aircraft mechanic programs for students across North Texas.
